ar.rough: بعد ذلك أريد أن أنضم لفريق مستودع أو نقل يطوّر طريقة عمله، وأتطور لدور فيه مسؤولية أكثر في التخطيط.

reality_notes: A previous planner rolled out a new route plan over a single weekend, and drivers ignored it because nobody had asked them about loading times and customer habits.
They also trusted the stock figures in the system, which were often wrong because returns and damaged goods were not recorded properly.
It worked much better once they spent time in the warehouse and on the routes before changing the plans.
